notes.title: 1.4.3, A Big Proper Patch!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! This is just another patch with a bunch of little tiny fixes, but I'm calling it big because it has a new feature of sorts! I had somebody reach out to me who told me that there were some accessibility issues with the game due to the sections with strict time limits. So, with this update, at the start of the game there is now an option to disable time limits! I still recommend leaving time limits enabled if you are able to, but if the time limits stop the game from being playable for you, or if you just don't want time limits in your chill puzzle game, feel free to turn them off!

Other stuff:
-Fixed some graphical issues
-Fixed some collision issues

Thank you all so much for playing BACKSPACE!!! :D

notes.title: Big patch of many little things!
notes.notes:
As the world has gained access to Backspace, a bunch of little issues have come to my attention that flew under the radar of me and my playtesters! This first proper patch fixes a bunch of little issues the Backspace community has discovered!

Here's what has been fixed!
-Fixed some incorrect portrait sprites
-Fixed a single silly typo
-Fixed a bug where you could soft lock yourself near the ending, OOPS
-Fixed a bug where a cutscene would repeat upon re-entering a room
-Fixed a bug where you could do the thing you do with the stapler (spoilers) multiple times and mess up things real bad, again, OOPS

I'm so glad you all are enjoying Backspace and thank you so much for playing!!!!
